The '''Kolmogorov Prize''' is a mathematical prize awarded by the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] for outstanding results in the field of mathematics. It bears the name of the mathematician [[Andrey Kolmogorov]].<ref>{{Cite journal |date=2008 |title=Notices |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/20059995 |journal=The Bulletin of Symbolic Logic |volume=14 |issue=3 |pages=444–448 |doi=10.2178/bsl/1231081378 |jstor=20059995 |issn=1079-8986|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

The award was established by a Decree of the Presidium of the Russian Academy of Sciences on February 23, 1993.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.ras.ru/rasawards/2d82fd3b-14f9-4c10-87a1-37b12b6e573e.aspx?hidetoc=0 |script-title=ru:Золотые медали Российской академии наук |language=ru |trans-title=Gold medals of the Russian Academy of Sciences |publisher=[[Russian Academy of Sciences]]}}</ref> As a rule, it is awarded every three years.

== Awarded Scientists ==
The following scientists have won the award:<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.ras.ru/win/db/award_dsc.asp?P=id-60.ln-ru |script-title=ru:Премия имени А.Н. Колмогорова |language=ru |trans-title=Prize named after A.N. Kolmogorov |publisher=[[Russian Academy of Sciences]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.ras.ru/about/awards/awdlist.aspx?awdid=60 |script-title=ru:Именные премии и медали |language=ru |trans-title=Nominal awards and medals |publisher=[[Russian Academy of Sciences]]}}</ref>

* [[1997 in science|1997]] — [[Nikolay Nekhoroshev]]

* [[2003 in science|2003]] — [[Anatoli Vitushkin]]

* [[2006 in science|2006]] — [[Andrey Muchnik]]

* [[2009 in science|2009]] — [[Valeriy Oseledets]]
* [[2009 in science|2009]] — [[Anatoly Styopin]]
* [[2012 in science|2012]] — [[Boris Kashin]]
* [[2015 in science|2015]] — [[Aleksandr Borovkov]]
* [[2015 in science|2015]] — [[Anatoly Mogulsky]]
* [[2018 in science|2018]] — [[Vladimir Bogachev]]
* [[2018 in science|2018]] — [[Stanislav Shaposhnikov]]
* [[2018 in science|2018]] — [[Andrey Kirillov (mathematician)|Andrey Kirillov]]
